content: ML /items/{id}/health endpoint (legacy): returns item_id, health (float 0-1), level (basic/standard/bronze/silver/gold/professional), goals[]. Each goal: id (e.g. price, free_shipping, technical_specification, picture, video, catalog_product_id, title, description, me2, financing), name, progress, progress_max, apply (bool), completed? (ISO8601). Fallback when /performance returns non-200. The project-antigo code maps goal IDs to PT-BR titles/labels.
